name: chat_resource
reportModel:
<#-- 1. 顶层循环保持不变 -->
<#list data as body>
    <#assign schema = body._schema!{}>
    <#assign dataSource = body._metadata!{}>
    <#if schema.definition?? && body.resource_name??>

# <#if body.title??>${body.title}<#else>${body.resource_name}</#if>

<@properties maps=schema.definition.properties!{} contents=dataSource level=2 parentName=schema.definition.name!"root"/>
    </#if>
</#list>
<#macro properties maps contents parentName level>
<#local titleLevel = (level > 6)?then(6, level) /><#local hashes = "" /><#list 1..titleLevel as i><#local hashes = hashes + "#" /></#list>

<#-- 1. 关键修复：表格上方必须有一个绝对的空行，且必须有一行文字表头 -->

<#--| - | - | - | - | - | - | -->
<#--|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|-->
<#local col = 0><#list maps?keys as key><#t>
<#local definition = maps[key]!><#t>
<#-- 过滤逻辑 -->
<#if key?upper_case?ends_with("_DM")><#t>
    <#local baseKey = key?upper_case?keep_before_last("_DM")><#t>
    <#if maps[baseKey + "_SHOW"]?? || maps[baseKey?lower_case + "_show"]?? || maps[baseKey + "DM_SHOW"]?? || maps[baseKey?lower_case + "dm_show"]?? || maps[baseKey + "_MC"]?? || maps[baseKey?lower_case + "_mc"]??><#continue></#if><#t>
</#if><#t>
<#if definition?is_hash && definition.type??><#t>
<#local schemaKey = definition.name!key /><#t>
<#local realKey = ""><#list contents?keys as cKey><#if cKey?upper_case == schemaKey?upper_case><#local realKey = cKey><#break></#if></#list><#t>
<#if realKey != ""><#t>
<#local value = contents[realKey]!><#t>
<#-- === 基础字段处理 === -->
<#if definition.type == "string" || definition.type == "number"><#t>
    <#if !value?is_hash><#t>
        <#local strValue = (definition.enumsource?? && definition.enumsource == 'YesNoDict')?then((value?string == "0")?then("否", "是"), value?is_number?then(value?c, value?is_date?then(value?string("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"), value?string!"[空]")))>
        <#local strValue = strValue?replace("\n", " ")?replace("\r", "")?replace("|", "|")?trim><#t>
        <#local isLong = (strValue?length > 40)><#t>
        <#if isLong><#t>
            <#if col != 0><#list col..5 as i> 　</#list>${'\n'}</#if><#t>
　 **${definition.title!schemaKey}** 　 ${strValue} 　 　 　 　 　${'\n'}<#local col = 0><#t>
        <#else><#t>
            <#if col == 0>　 <#else> </#if>**${definition.title!schemaKey}** 　 ${strValue} 　<#t>
            <#local col = col + 2><#t>
            <#if col == 6><#local col = 0>${'\n'}</#if><#t>
        </#if><#t>
    </#if><#t>
<#-- === 对象和数组处理 (跳出表格) === -->
<#elseif (definition.type == "object" || definition.type == "array")><#t>
    <#if col != 0><#list col..5 as i> 　</#list>${'\n'}</#if><#local col = 0><#t>
    <#if definition.type == "object" && value?is_hash><#t>

${hashes} ${(definition.title!schemaKey)?replace("表(", "(")}
<@properties maps=definition.properties!{} contents=value parentName=parentName + "." + schemaKey level=level+1/>
    <#elseif definition.type == "array" && value?is_sequence && value?size gt 0><#t>

${hashes} ${(definition.title!schemaKey)?replace("明细", "")}
        <#if definition.items?? && definition.items?is_hash><#t>
            <#list value as item><#t>
                <#if item?is_hash><#t>

${hashes}# ${(definition.title!schemaKey)?replace("明细", "")} ${item_index + 1}
<@properties maps=definition.items.properties!{} contents=item parentName=parentName + "." + schemaKey + (item_index + 1) level=level+2/>
                </#if><#t>
            </#list><#t>
        </#if><#t>
    </#if><#t>
</#if><#t>
</#if><#t>
</#if><#t>
</#list><#t>
<#if col != 0><#list col..5 as i> 　</#list></#if>

</#macro>
